customers.background: Plans household purchases for a family and normally shops once a week.
customers.shopping_preferences: Practical groceries, children's essentials, and durable household products; avoids gift vouchers.
customers.typical_spending: Regular supermarket visits, public transport, and occasional family meals, mostly during daytime.
customers.travel_pattern: One or two short trips to neighbouring countries each year.

customers.background: Travels regularly for consulting work and separates travel spending from everyday purchases.
customers.shopping_preferences: Flexible hotel bookings near public transport and simple expense documentation.
customers.typical_spending: Frequent rail, hotel, and restaurant payments in Switzerland, Germany, and France.
customers.travel_pattern: Regular business travel in Germany and France.

customers.background: Spends weekends hiking and climbing, with seasonal trips across the nearby Italian border.
customers.shopping_preferences: Repairable outdoor equipment and specialist sports shops rather than fashion purchases.
customers.typical_spending: Sports purchases, fuel, casual dining, and periodic EUR transactions in northern Italy.
customers.travel_pattern: Seasonal leisure travel in Italy.

customers.background: Works rotating hospital shifts and often buys meals and essentials outside standard office hours.
customers.shopping_preferences: Fast grocery delivery and practical meals after late shifts; avoids energy drinks.
customers.typical_spending: Groceries, meal delivery, transport, and pharmacy purchases, including legitimate late-night activity.
customers.travel_pattern: Rarely travels abroad.

customers.background: Studies part-time while working and relies on several digital learning services.
customers.shopping_preferences: Books and learning tools with transparent prices; no automatic premium upgrades.
customers.typical_spending: Small recurring subscriptions, book purchases, transport, and inexpensive cafés.
customers.travel_pattern: Occasional domestic trips only.

customers.background: Runs and cycles throughout the year and replaces equipment only when needed.
customers.shopping_preferences: Technical sports equipment from specialist retailers and products with clear return terms.
customers.typical_spending: Frequent modest sports purchases with occasional higher-value shoes or cycling equipment.
customers.travel_pattern: Weekend trips within Switzerland and Austria.

customers.background: Is gradually renovating an apartment and plans each room as a separate project.
customers.shopping_preferences: Simple repairable fittings, neutral colours, and click-and-collect when available.
customers.typical_spending: Home-improvement stores, household purchases, transport, and occasional furniture deliveries.
customers.travel_pattern: Rare short visits to France.

customers.background: Coordinates purchases for children and an older relative as well as her own household.
customers.shopping_preferences: Reliable delivery windows, clearly sized children's items, and familiar pharmacies.
customers.typical_spending: Groceries, family supplies, health purchases, and household orders across two cards.
customers.travel_pattern: One family holiday in Europe each year.

customers.background: Shares an apartment with two friends and manages a rotating household shopping list.
customers.shopping_preferences: Shared essentials in normal pack sizes and receipts that are easy to split.
customers.typical_spending: Groceries and household goods from recurring local merchants, plus shared meal deliveries.
customers.travel_pattern: Occasional weekend travel.

customers.background: Works independently as a designer and uses a separate card for business tools and travel.
customers.shopping_preferences: Month-to-month software, clear invoices, and no bundled consulting services.
customers.typical_spending: Software subscriptions, electronics, cafés, and occasional foreign-currency online services.
customers.travel_pattern: Several European client trips each year.

customers.background: Prefers nearby physical shops and normally pays for everyday items in person.
customers.shopping_preferences: Local products, simple receipts, and collection from a store rather than delivery.
customers.typical_spending: Daytime in-store groceries, transport, clothing, and occasional restaurant purchases.
customers.travel_pattern: Rarely travels abroad.

customers.background: Uses a phone wallet for most everyday purchases and keeps a separate travel card.
customers.shopping_preferences: Mobile receipts, fast checkout, and Italian or Swiss fashion retailers with returns.
customers.typical_spending: High mobile-wallet usage for clothing, dining, groceries, and cross-border trips.
customers.travel_pattern: Regular short trips to Italy.

customers.background: Repairs products where possible and chooses refill or second-life options for routine shopping.
customers.shopping_preferences: Reusable, refurbished, or repairable items with transparent materials.
customers.typical_spending: Groceries, repair services, second-life goods, public transport, and few impulse purchases.
customers.travel_pattern: Mostly domestic travel.

customers.background: Attends concerts and festivals in summer but spends little on entertainment during the rest of the year.
customers.shopping_preferences: Standard admission from clear ticket sellers; no VIP or resale upgrades.
customers.typical_spending: Seasonal clusters of event purchases alongside normal groceries, transport, and dining.
customers.travel_pattern: Domestic events and occasional German concerts.

customers.background: Enjoys photography and saves for occasional equipment rather than buying accessories frequently.
customers.shopping_preferences: Compatible camera equipment from specialist shops, with a return window and no financing.
customers.typical_spending: Mostly modest daily spending interrupted by rare, planned high-value photography purchases.
customers.travel_pattern: Occasional landscape photography trips.

customers.background: Owns a dog and receives repeat deliveries of food and routine care products.
customers.shopping_preferences: The usual pet-food formula, dependable delivery, and no unrequested supplement substitutions.
customers.typical_spending: Recurring pet-care payments mixed with groceries, transport, health, and park-side cafés.
customers.travel_pattern: Rarely travels without the dog.

customers.background: Recently moved within Switzerland and is still establishing new local shopping routines.
customers.shopping_preferences: Practical household basics and merchants that offer clear delivery dates.
customers.typical_spending: A wider-than-usual variety of new grocery, household, transport, and home-improvement merchants.
customers.travel_pattern: Occasional travel to France and Sweden.

customers.background: Keeps personal daily spending separate from a shared household account.
customers.shopping_preferences: Predictable grocery orders, clearly separated receipts, and household staples in normal quantities.
customers.typical_spending: Frequent groceries and transport on one card, with shared household purchases on another account.
customers.travel_pattern: A few European city trips each year.

customers.background: Researches online purchases carefully and uses a virtual card for web shops.
customers.shopping_preferences: Known electronics sellers, clear warranty terms, and no marketplace add-ons.
customers.typical_spending: Few online purchases, repeated familiar merchants, and mostly local in-store daily spending.
customers.travel_pattern: Rarely travels abroad.

customers.background: Balances a busy schedule with frequent grocery and prepared-meal deliveries.
customers.shopping_preferences: Reliable delivery estimates, saved food preferences, and no automatic membership enrolment.
customers.typical_spending: Frequent small ecommerce and mobile-wallet payments, especially food delivery and groceries.
customers.travel_pattern: Occasional holidays in southern Europe.

customers.background: Photographs landscapes in the Winterthur area and buys a lens perhaps once a year.
customers.shopping_preferences: Compatible camera equipment from specialist shops, with a return window and no financing.
customers.typical_spending: Small everyday payments and rare planned equipment purchases.
customers.travel_pattern: A few European city trips each year.

customers.background: Spends many weekends in Germany and France and prefers refundable bookings.
customers.shopping_preferences: Refundable hotel rates, rail tickets, and no travel insurance add-ons.
customers.typical_spending: Frequent travel-related purchases and dining in several currencies.
customers.travel_pattern: Frequent weekend trips to Germany.

customers.background: Goes to early-morning classes and tracks meals with a subscription app.
customers.shopping_preferences: Monthly memberships that can be paused, and no annual upfront plans.
customers.typical_spending: Early-morning purchases near the gym and monthly subscription charges.
customers.travel_pattern: A family holiday in France once a year.

customers.background: Spends many weekends in France and the United States and prefers refundable bookings.
customers.shopping_preferences: Booking directly with hotels and rail operators rather than resellers.
customers.typical_spending: Monthly hotel and rail bookings, restaurants abroad, and ordinary groceries at home.
customers.travel_pattern: Regular short trips to France and Austria.

customers.background: Streams games in the evening and orders dinner online most nights.
customers.shopping_preferences: Monthly plans that can be paused and no in-app upsells.
customers.typical_spending: Mostly online spending after 18:00 and little in-store activity.
customers.travel_pattern: Occasional domestic trips only.

customers.background: Lives in a shared flat in Winterthur where the grocery run rotates weekly between flatmates.
customers.shopping_preferences: Familiar supermarkets and the same meal-delivery service every time.
customers.typical_spending: Frequent small grocery and delivery payments and very few large ones.
customers.travel_pattern: A family holiday in Germany once a year.

customers.background: Relies on delivery apps for meals and household basics during the week.
customers.shopping_preferences: Quick reorders of the usual items and no premium delivery tiers.
customers.typical_spending: Many small online payments in the evening and few in-store purchases.
customers.travel_pattern: Weekend trips within Switzerland and Austria.

customers.background: Relocated from Germany and has not yet settled on regular merchants.
customers.shopping_preferences: Furniture and basics for the new flat, delivered on a fixed date.
customers.typical_spending: Household setup purchases, groceries from several different supermarkets, and transport.
customers.travel_pattern: A few European city trips each year.

customers.background: Manages two households' groceries and pharmacy runs on separate cards.
customers.shopping_preferences: Separate receipts per household, familiar pharmacies, and predictable delivery days.
customers.typical_spending: Steady mid-sized grocery and health spending with few large purchases.
customers.travel_pattern: A family holiday in France once a year.

customers.background: Runs and ski-tours most weekends and drives to trailheads in Germany in spring and autumn.
customers.shopping_preferences: Technical gear from specialist retailers, sold in standard sizes with a return window.
customers.typical_spending: Sports purchases, fuel, casual dining, and periodic EUR transactions in Germany.
customers.travel_pattern: Several trips to Germany and Austria each year.

scenario_catalogue.cardholder_instruction: Buy one ordinary grocery item for CHF 20 or less from a shop I use regularly. Ask me when uncertain.
Do the weekly grocery shopping online at supermarkets I already use. Never spend more than CHF 100 per order or CHF 250 in any 7-day window; groceries and household basics only. If unsure, ask.
I need new hiking boots, size 42, from a proper sports shop. Maximum CHF 180, and I must be able to return them within at least 14 days. Nothing else in the basket. If anything is unclear, ask me.

Allow small electronics and accessories purchases up to CHF 300 each at retailers I already use. If the session looks unusual — a new device, a burst of orders, unfamiliar shops abroad — stop and ask me.
Buy the camera lens I chose, from a seller I have bought from before, for CHF 900 or less. Do not add anything I did not ask for. Ask me when uncertain.
Keep my current subscriptions running. Total per month must stay under CHF 80. No new services, no premium tiers, no annual prepayments. If a price changes, ask me.
Order hiking boots, size 46, from the Austrian outdoor retailer I already know. Pay no more than EUR 200 and only if they can be returned. Ask me if anything is unclear.
Weeknight dinners only: one delivery a day, CHF 40 maximum including the delivery fee, from my usual services. Never at the weekend. Ask me if something doesn't fit.
Book me a hotel in Munich for 3 nights from 10 September to 13 September, at most CHF 200 per night, refundable rate only. No flights, no insurance. Ask me when uncertain.
Groceries and everyday household items only, maximum CHF 100 per order, from the shops I use. No alcohol, no gift cards, no cosmetics. When in doubt, ask.
